title: Normalized comparison decompositions over all bases
statement: For every finite commutative ring A, positive N annihilating A, there exist a Chern family c, twisted isomorphism family b and untwisted decomposition family d satisfying SpP1NormalizedDecompositions A N hN hA c b d [def-sp-p1-proetale-trace-system]. Both maps are the specified comparison images; their unit and normalized Kummer components are fixed.

source.place: Proof paragraphs 1--2: untwisted decomposition, positive twist, comparison, and arbitrary-base existence

proof.text: Choose the universal Noetherian N-invertible base. The ordinary projective-line decomposition there supplies an invertible canonical untwisted map after each base morphism.

Take the already stated global normalized twisted Kummer splitting family. Injectivity of the arbitrary-base class map identifies its Chern arrow with the one just supplied by the untwisted decomposition.

Apply exact comparison. Its canonical direct-image mate is invertible on single objects and their shifts. Transport its derived presentation through the canonical exact comparison isomorphisms; the mate whiskering identities identify it with geoP1PushComparison.

The biproduct comparison is invertible. Define d by the specified composite and b by asIso of the specified twisted composite. Additive preservation of the two injections proves the required unit and Chern component formulas.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_spP1NormalizedDecompositions
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hA : (N : A) = 0) :
    ∃ (c : SpP1ChernFamily A N hA) (b : SpP1TwistedFamily A N hA)
      (d : SpP1DecompositionFamily A N hA),
      SpP1NormalizedDecompositions A N hN hA c b d
